runtime.execution: Async server persists agent/block/message/run/step state; V3 model adapter streams then dispatches typed server or client tools.
runtime.service_boundary: Historical server owns persistent agent memory/state and sandbox execution; consumes providers/MCP/E2B; current Letta implementation is a separate source tree.

summary: Memory-editing model agent with searchable persisted messages, managed compaction, tool rules, approval handoff and multi-agent service primitives.

inspection.scope: V3 request/dispatch/checkpoint/compaction, tool execution/sandbox, memory/search/messaging and historical direct test assertions
inspection.limits: Retired implementation only; no live APIs/tests. Older agent/group classes coexist and their mechanisms are not automatically the V3 entry path.

actions.name: V3 step / stream
actions.input: agent/conversation, user/approval messages, max_steps and stream settings
actions.output: stream messages, run/step/tool IDs, stop reason
actions.lifecycle: provider then tools/checkpoint; pause on approval/client handoff

actions.name: ToolExecutionManager.execute_tool_async
actions.input: function name/args, Tool type/config and step ID
actions.lifecycle: await typed executor; cancellation reports error without remote settlement

actions.name: memory_replace (and sibling insert/rethink/patch)
actions.input: block label, unique old string/new string
actions.output: updated model-visible memory or validation error
actions.lifecycle: next request uses block; separate service persistence

actions.name: conversation_search
actions.input: query, roles, limit; signature also date args
actions.output: formatted matching message text/roles or no results
actions.lifecycle: service query projection, date args ignored by this native implementation
actions.authority: same agent actor; omitted record classes explicit

actions.name: compact / compact_messages
actions.input: messages, per-call/agent compaction settings, model/tools and trigger/stats
actions.output: attributed summary and new system/summary/tail context
actions.lifecycle: new provider request; original objects kept apart from context IDs

actions.name: send_message_to_agent_and_wait_for_reply
actions.output: formatted target ID and assistant reply
actions.lifecycle: synchronous API chain; automatically attributed but input may be lowercase duplicated

actions.name: send_message_to_agent_async
actions.lifecycle: not a nonblocking pending delivery handle; rejects prod Cloud

actions.name: _checkpoint_messages
actions.input: completed new messages and current context IDs, run/step/conversation IDs
actions.output: persisted objects and selected context position
actions.lifecycle: only successful/safe-step checkpoint; split persistence calls after effects

filesystem.detail: Typed file/custom tool sandbox execution is wired; direct mode executes generated Python with fresh globals and process-global stdout/env mutation, E2B optional.

processes.detail: Typed file/custom tool sandbox execution is wired; direct mode executes generated Python with fresh globals and process-global stdout/env mutation, E2B optional.

code_actions.detail: Typed file/custom tool sandbox execution is wired; direct mode executes generated Python with fresh globals and process-global stdout/env mutation, E2B optional.

persistent_kernel.detail: Local direct exec has fresh globals; environment/venv/E2B reuse is not a contracted shared standing interpreter heap.

standing_database.detail: Agent memory blocks, messages and in-context IDs persist through service managers; archival memory is another service primitive, not model-governed infrastructure.

workflow_programming.detail: Tool rules/terminal/approval/client handoff and group orchestration compose server loops; no arbitrary model-authored orchestration program in traced V3 paths.

multi_model.detail: Agent provider/config and configurable summarizer model, plus distinct participant agents; not solely model selection mistaken for collaboration.

live_collaboration.detail: Agent-to-agent service API and historical speaker runner exist; one-way async-named tool is sync create and forbidden in production Cloud, no room/event delivery contract.

concurrent_work.detail: Only tools marked parallel gathered; gathered group executes before serial group, result order restored by index.

steering_interrupt.detail: Model invocation/client approval handoff and async cancellation exist; CancelledError becomes tool error but arbitrary local/E2B side effects may continue or be partial.

turn_redefinition.detail: Memory/tool/config and compaction policy influence next step; actual model loop/scheduling remains server code, not general hot program turn.

compaction.detail: Configurable summary/sliding/other compaction modes build new context, rebuild memory/system and persist identified summary before overflow retry.

context_repair.detail: Searchable original message objects separated from context IDs and memory edits provide repair inputs; search projection omits roles/tool records and date filters are not forwarded by native helper.

original_audit.detail: Messages/run/step attribution retained, but action return trimmed before persistence and direct exec/global capture does not cover every original provider/OS byte.

audit_query.detail: Message ID/query retrieval useful; native conversation_search forwards only query/roles/limit and searchable projection excludes specific tools/nonchat roles.

hot_change.detail: Memory/block and configuration changes refresh next request, compaction repairs persisted system; no wired server executable hot reload traced.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Persistent message/context/agent state loads future requests; completed-step checkpoint not an atomic external action journal and no active program/provider refit migration.

remote_services.detail: Provider model adapters, MCP executor/E2B and agent-message APIs; historical server governance separate from Arconaut consumer.

self_improvement.detail: Model edits memory/skills/config and separate sleeptime types exist; traced path does not establish experimental evaluated harness promotion.

complaints.detail: Step/tool error/stdout/stderr and telemetry context useful diagnostics; full captured-state complaint tracking not established.

authority.detail: Actor organization and tool roster/types/approval rules; client-side actions return approval request boundary rather than executed by server.

evaluation.detail: Exact threshold test useful for policy calculations; inspected summary attribution test suppresses all exceptions and cannot certify output success/fidelity.

time_order.detail: Context position/run/step IDs and indexed result order; parallel-before-serial scheduling differs from original call-list effect order.

evidence.claim: This source identifies itself as legacy V1 API; active development and self-hosting moved to letta-code App Server.
V3 builds provider request from messages/memory/system/config and allowed tools.
Actual model adapter streams invocation with requires-approval/client tool set and actor/step attribution.
Tool type selects core/memory/files/builtin/MCP/sandbox executor; fallback custom tool executes in sandbox.
Exec awaits typed executor then truncates return payload to tool char limit; CancelledError converted to error/stderr, not proof remote action stopped.
Eligible parallel tool batch gather runs before sequential tools, results put in original indices; not global call-list side-effect order.
Safe completed-step checkpoint persists message objects separately from in-context message-ID/conversation ordering; external tool effect precedes this point.
Compaction constructs attributed summary and final system/summary/tail list; original message DB is not deleted by this helper.
Overflow compaction rebuilds persisted system/memory, refreshes messages and checkpoints summary/context before retry provider.
Compaction configurable per call/agent defaults/model and statistics, passes available tools for self-summary/cache compatibility.
Configured E2B vs local sandbox dispatch; environment/runtime branch explicit, not a permanent universal kernel.
Direct Python execution creates fresh globals but temporarily redirects process-global stdout/stderr and environment; no retained heap guarantee.
conversation_search implementation calls message-manager query_text/roles/limit; documented date args are not forwarded in this path.
Search projection only assistant/user/tool roles and omits send_message/conversation_search tool records; not complete audit query coverage.
memory_replace requires unique exact text, updates model-visible block and returns value; ambiguity fails.
Synchronous agent messaging uses service API, automatically adds sender identity but duplicates mixed-case text lowercase before dispatch.
One-way messaging explicitly disallowed prod Cloud; implementation calls non-stream create synchronously, return confirmation not live-peer delivery handle.
Separate older group runner loads agents and iterates speakers; not evidence V3 arbitrary live concurrent room.
Exact numeric family thresholds/force-proactive behavior tested; not semantic compaction correctness.
Summary test catches all exceptions then asserts telemetry context attribution only; cannot prove summarization succeeds.

tests.oracle: Exact 90% GPT5/proactive and full nonGPT threshold; not summary correctness.
Mocks assert agent/tags/run/step/call_type, but blanket exception suppression permits failed summary; explicitly limited oracle.

strengths: Persisted message objects distinct from compacted context IDs.
Model-native precise memory edits and conversation retrieval support continuity.
Executor type and client approval boundaries explicit.
limits: Retired V1 cannot stand in for current Letta Code.
Return truncation before persistence/search projection limits original audit.
Direct local exec mutates global capture/env and does not give persistent kernel or reliable quiescence.
arconaut_questions: How can retrieval see every original while serving bounded context?
Do advertised search inputs actually reach query execution?
Should parallel mutation ordering be explicit in model-facing program semantics?
